wins: Consistently completed the reconnaissance phase by mapping 100% of accessible hosts without crashes.
Maintained reliable telemetry with 10 mentor call hand-offs handled smoothly.
fails: Failed to escalate privileges beyond user level for the single episode, resulting in 0% success rate.
Repeated misalignment with the mission objective despite gathering relevant intelligence.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and stability were solid, but follow-on exploitation and objective completion need targeted refinement.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts stalled after initial foothold due to missing post-exploit toolset.

skill_cards.then_action: Run protocol-specific enumeration using nmap service/version scripts

skill_cards.then_action: Deploy SSH user enumeration and timing scans to refine credential list

skill_cards.if_condition: When Windows services list permits remote SMB interaction
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke smbclient scripts to list shares and identify writable targets

memory_ops.reason: High reliability in mapping attacker surface early in the episode.
Consistent detection of SSH banner variants indicated structured enumeration workflows.
